EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Al Kanz Prize Linked Account Eligibility
Hi,
As per the terms and conditions of Al Kanz Prize Linked account , Bank ABC and ila Bank staff and their immediate relatives are not eligible to participate in prize draws.
{!Linked_Account__c.Linked_Account__c} has advised us that you are his/her relative. Because of this, we have marked your Al Kanz account as ineligible.
We are collecting this information due to regulatory requirements, as we are unable to offer to our staff and their immediate relatives a product like Al Kanz. We will process your personal data according to the ila Privacy Notice
This does not affect your other accounts or your relationship with ila.
The balance, if any, in your Al Kanz account will be transferred to your BHD Currency Account.
If you believe there has been an error, please contact us on 17123456.
Bank ABC Tower, Head Office, P.O Box: 5698, Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain
If you have received this message in error, please notify our contact center of the error and delete the message.
Licensed as a Conventional Retail Bank – Branch by the Central Bank of Bahrain
